findings.evidence: Lines 278-286 and 330-336 are verbatim identical after renaming `v.1` to `i`; both are consumed only through `hgarm`.
findings.fix: State it once, e.g. `lemma starMark_some_eq (i : α) (s : Fin (ℓ i)) : starMark ℓ (some ⟨i, s⟩) = ((ℓ i : ℚ) + 1 - ((s : ℕ) + 1)) * ∏ j ∈ ({i}ᶜ : Finset α), ((ℓ j : ℚ) + 1)`, the arm-vertex companion of the existing `starMark_none_eq`, and use it at both sites.
findings.issue: The closed form of the marks along an arm is re-derived inline instead of being a lemma. `sum_starCartanMatrix_mul_starMark_some` (278-286) and `sum_starCartanMatrix_mul_starMark_none` (330-336) each set up the same `Q`/`g` abbreviations and prove the same `hgarm : g (s + 1) = starMark ℓ (some ⟨i, s⟩)` by `rw [hg, starMark_some]; push_cast; ring`, differing only in `v.1` vs `i`.

findings.evidence: Lines 167-170 prove `starMark ℓ none = ((ℓ i : ℚ) + 1) * ∏ j ∈ ({i}ᶜ : Finset α), ((ℓ j : ℚ) + 1)`; lines 382-383 re-prove the same splitting with `Finset.mul_prod_erase`.

findings.issue: Same problem, third instance: `hterm : ((ℓ i : ℚ) + 1)⁻¹ * ∏ j, ((ℓ j : ℚ) + 1) = ∏ j ∈ ({i}ᶜ), ((ℓ j : ℚ) + 1)` is proved from scratch via `Finset.compl_singleton`/`Finset.mul_prod_erase`, which is exactly the content of the already-proved `starMark_none_eq i` (167-170) divided by `ℓ i + 1`. `hsplit` at 353-359 does reuse `starMark_none_eq`; `hterm` does not.

findings.evidence: Lines 458, 483, 491, 499 carry the same rewrite; `Fintype.card_fin` also makes the `show … from by norm_num` unnecessary.

findings.fix: Either state it as `starCartanMatrix ℓ none none = chainEntry 0 0` like the siblings, or prove the `= 2` form through `chainEntry_self 0` rather than raw `rfl`, so a later reformulation of `chainEntry` does not silently break it.
findings.issue: `starCartanMatrix_none_none : starCartanMatrix ℓ none none = 2 := (rfl)` is the only one of the four unfolding lemmas whose `rfl` also evaluates `chainEntry 0 0` through its `if`-cascade, chaining defeq across two definitions whose bodies are deliberately unexposed; its siblings (128-136) stop at `chainEntry …`.

summary: Proofs are readable, commented, and use robust automation (omega, ring, linear_combination, nlinarith) with no change/show and no long brittle rewrite chains. The one real defect is a reusable fact about starMark along an arm that is never stated and is instead re-derived inline three times.
